lead_story.topic: Brewers edge Padres 3-2 in NLDS Game 1 after Ty France roof controversy
lead_story.headline: Brewers survive Padres 3-2 in NLDS opener after roof robs France of potential go-ahead homer

tweets.text:
FINAL: Brewers 3, Padres 2

What a tremendous game. Battle of the bullpens decided by William Contreras' go-ahead homer and a horrendous bit of luck for San Diego when a potential go-ahead shot by Ty France in the ninth clanged off the roof and was caught by Jackson Chourio.

lead_story.research_notes: TIER 1 ELIMINATION-ROUND OPENER per calendar: NLDS Game 1, first of best-of-7 Division Series. William Contreras go-ahead HR in 7th gave Milwaukee 3-2 lead. THE CONTROVERSY: Ty France 9th-inning fly ball hit roof at American Family Field, caught by Jackson Chourio, ruled out after review. France: 'You would think with all technology we have now we'd be able to make clear call on that. That shouldn't be an out.' JayCuda batted-ball data: 49° launch, 105-106 mph exit velo — showed similar batted balls that were HRs. CBS Sports headline: 'Were Padres robbed of go-ahead homer vs Brewers? Why Ty France's ninth-inning fly ball was ruled an out.' JeffPassan: 'horrendous bit of luck for San Diego when potential go-ahead shot by France clanged off roof and was caught by Chourio.' Jacob Misiorowski threw 5 pitches at 104+ MPH in first inning alone — youngest Brewers pitcher in postseason history. Trevor Megill sat down Tatis on three straight fastballs. Luis Campusano broken-bat RBI single in 3rd gave Padres first lead. Both teams threatened to score every inning after 2-2 tie. Historical: Brewers no World Series title in franchise history, last WS appearance 1982. Padres no WS title in franchise history, last WS appearance 1998. Brewers fans: look at Leinenkugel's collared shirt king, Tito's lid, phone front pocket, scowl that's seen too much Brewers postseason sadness (via CespedesBBQ). The roof rule: if ball hits roof in fair territory and is caught, it's an out — that's the rule, but does the rule make sense when the ball clearly would have been a HR in any other park? France and Padres feel robbed. Milwaukee takes 1-0 series lead, Game 2 Sunday.
